description:
In front of Ji-su, who has a thing for chests, stands his childhood friend Jae-hee. Jae-hee’s chest looked soft and firm, and Ji-su can’t stop staring at it. He knows he shouldn’t, but...

*“Hyung, wanna touch my chest?”*

Jae-hee, you can’t be doing this! Wait, or maybe... you can?
Ji-su’s love is led by his heart... and his chest!
